turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm buying a new mattress and I've narrowed it down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a firm memory foam mattress that a lot of reviews say is great for back pain.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a soft pillow top spring mattress, really cozy, but it might sag after a few years.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a hybrid with springs and foam, medium firm, and a bit more expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you sleep on your side, back or stomach? Side sleepers usually like something softer, so the hybrid could be ideal. If you have back pain, I'd try the firm foam one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I can only fit in my workouts at ten at night. Is that wrecking my sleep?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For some people it does, because intense exercise raises your heart rate and body temperature. Others sleep fine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I know which one I am?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Notice how long it takes to fall asleep on workout nights versus rest nights.
